title: Transition W14: disposition the ADR 0020 reassessment artifacts with bounded in-band scope
description:
Workstream W14 (artifact-disposition half) of the integrated ADR 0020 transition
design, sections 5.1-5.6:
docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md.
That design is the accepted deliverable of eshyra-o9bd.19.8 (PR #485, reviewed
head afd113c7090378c3a9f4122f246a6c32602a5164, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282). ADR 0020 controls.

OWNER
This bead owns the section 5.1-5.6 artifact dispositions. It does NOT own the
re-freeze bar or the thaw gate: those stay with eshyra-o9bd.14 (regenerate and
re-freeze) and eshyra-2zyy (thaw-note CI gating), and this bead is the provider
of the artifact-disposition evidence those owners require. The engine-family
narrowing is recorded on eshyra-olc5, and the capability-contract shape belongs
to W13.

SCOPE - six dispositions, each confirmed, narrowed, repurposed, or retired with
reasons, none deleted for tidiness and none grandfathered:

1. section 5.1 RETAIN AS BOUNDED REGRESSION GUARDS - srdPlayabilityAudit,
   srdChoiceProseAudit, srdEquipmentResolutionAudit. Each module's header states
   in band that a green result is scoped to its enumerated categories and is not
   evidence of global source, discovery, adjudication, or capability
   completeness. No scope widening is authorized.
2. section 5.2 NARROW GAMEPLAY_READINESS_DISPOSITIONS to a non-exhaustive
   historical and diagnostic-signal report. Withdraw the partition and closure
   claims: the buckets do not partition the corpus, an unrecognized record is not
   satisfied, a closed bead pointer does not prove an obligation resolved, and
   zero bucket findings does not prove pack readiness. Label the report
   non-exhaustive in band and in emitted output; record the 197 bucket-less
   records as a stated scope gap rather than an implied green; correct or replace
   hasMechanicsProjection's empty-object acceptance with
   hasSubstantiveMechanicsProjection; convert each finding pointer into a durable
   finding-registry reference. PRESERVE EXACTLY: ACCEPTED_PROSE_RECORD_KEYS,
   ACCEPTED_METADATA_ONLY_SPELLS, CREATURE_ENTRY_REVIEWED_DISPOSITIONS - these
   key-pinned membership registries stay load-bearing and must not be discarded
   with the bucket mechanism.
3. section 5.3 BOUND RULE_DISPOSITIONS to an exact classification of rule:*
   records and only that. It must not be generalized into corpus-wide semantic
   ownership, discovery completeness, capability completeness, or exclusive
   clause ownership. Add an in-band scope statement and replace the count-pinned
   EXPECTED_SEMANTIC_CENSUS with identity-pinned assertions, so an equal-size
   reclassification cannot pass.
4. section 5.4 SPLIT ENGINE_PROCEDURE_COVERAGE into its three conflated
   responsibilities: (a) an adjudication-context inventory - what a
   model-adjudicated procedure must have retrievable at play time, today the
   unread free-text contextRequirement; (b) positive deterministic-capability
   bindings - the implemented rows with runtimeOwner and evidence, restated in the
   ADR 0020 five-field shape and handed to W13; (c) unresolved, deferred, or
   design-blocked work - partial, unimplemented, design-blocked, and
   externalClauses rows. ADR 0018 section 6 reporting obligations are preserved:
   the ten design-blocked multiclass rows keep being reported as deliberately
   deferred even though their eshyra-2n1t.1/.2 pointers are stale.
5. section 5.5 RECORD THE BOUNDED MEANING of engine:F1-engine:F10 as the
   generated magic-item capability backlog - 240 magic-item records with
   executionReadiness, 1,016 clauses, 795 declaring engine hooks - and not a
   corpus-wide engine inventory. The eshyra-olc5 families are reassessed against
   that bounded scope, not deleted; 221 of 240 items still carry at least one
   engine-pending or design-blocked clause.
6. section 5.6 BOUND THE ADR 0019 CENSUS to a generated field-level census. Its
   one-disposition-per-candidate convention is per-field bookkeeping and must not
   become exclusive clause, procedure, discovery, or capability ownership; a
   record may carry a typed projection and an untyped residual for the same
   concept (equipment:battleaxe). Discovery may use the census as an input to
   exploratory-band candidate generation and to projection-limit disclosure, never
   as an ownership claim. The ADR-level review remains ADR 0019's own successor.

CLOSED-BEAD POINTERS may not remain the only durable identity for an unresolved
obligation. After the split, each unresolved row carries a durable
finding-registry identity from eshyra-o9bd.19.1.15, with the bead pointer
retained as history.

NON-GOALS
- This bead disposes ARTIFACTS, not findings. It closes, retires, narrows, and
  downgrades no finding; bulk finding disposition is sequenced after the durable
  registry exists (eshyra-o9bd.19.1.15).
- It does not implement the new re-freeze bar and does not re-freeze anything.
- It creates no new audit or proof system: strengthen or repurpose what exists
  (ADR 0017 section 8).
- It asserts no global deterministic closure, no universal discovery
  completeness, and no corpus-wide capability inventory.
- It does not widen any retained audit's scope.

DEPENDENCIES
eshyra-o9bd.19.1.15 (W6, durable finding registry) wherever a durable finding
identity is required - the section 5.2 finding pointers and the section 5.4
unresolved rows. The in-band scope statements (sections 5.1, 5.3 statement, 5.6)
are parallel-safe and need not wait.

PERMANENT EVIDENCE
In-band scope statements in each named module and in emitted report text;
identity-pinned censuses replacing count-pinned ones; the recorded 197-record
scope gap; the corrected mechanics-projection predicate; the three-way
ENGINE_PROCEDURE_COVERAGE split with ADR 0018 reporting preserved; durable
finding-registry references replacing bead-shaped strings.

REQUIRED NEXT STATE
Every artifact in ADR 0020's reassessment list states its scope in band and
claims nothing outside it - condition 4 of the nine-condition re-freeze bar
(design section 5.9) - so that eshyra-o9bd.14 and eshyra-2zyy can evaluate that
condition against evidence rather than assertion.

MATERIAL CHANGE: yes. It narrows the claims of existing readiness and coverage
artifacts and splits one of them.
acceptance_criteria:
srdPlayabilityAudit, srdChoiceProseAudit, and srdEquipmentResolutionAudit each
carry an in-band scope statement that a green result covers only its enumerated
categories and is not evidence of global source, discovery, adjudication, or
capability completeness; none has its scope widened.
GAMEPLAY_READINESS_DISPOSITIONS is labelled non-exhaustive in code and in emitted
output, no longer claims that its buckets partition the corpus or that an
unrecognized record is satisfied, records the 197 bucket-less records as a stated
scope gap, no longer accepts an empty mechanics object as a projection, and
replaces each bead-shaped finding pointer with a durable finding-registry
reference; ACCEPTED_PROSE_RECORD_KEYS, ACCEPTED_METADATA_ONLY_SPELLS, and
CREATURE_ENTRY_REVIEWED_DISPOSITIONS survive unchanged. RULE_DISPOSITIONS states
in band that it classifies rule:* records and nothing else, and its count-pinned
EXPECTED_SEMANTIC_CENSUS is replaced by identity-pinned assertions that an
equal-size reclassification cannot pass. ENGINE_PROCEDURE_COVERAGE is split into
an adjudication-context inventory, positive deterministic-capability bindings
handed to W13 in the ADR 0020 five-field shape, and unresolved/deferred/
design-blocked work; ADR 0018 section 6 reporting of the deliberately deferred
multiclass procedures is preserved, and every unresolved row carries a durable
finding-registry identity with its historical bead pointer retained. Every place
that reports engine:F1-engine:F10 states in band that they are the generated
magic-item capability backlog and not a corpus-wide engine inventory. The ADR
0019 census states that one-disposition-per-candidate is per-field bookkeeping
and not exclusive clause, procedure, discovery, or capability ownership. No
finding is closed, retired, narrowed, or reclassified by this work; no artifact
is deleted for tidiness; no new proof or audit system is introduced; and nothing
here asserts global deterministic closure, universal discovery completeness, or
corpus-wide capability completeness.

TRACEABILITY: every bead in the W7-W15 set was created 2026-07-31 to execute the
design accepted as the deliverable of eshyra-o9bd.19.8 (PR #485, reviewed head
afd113c7090378c3a9f4122f246a6c32602a5164, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282). They are parented to the ACTIVE
transition epic (eshyra-o9bd.19, or eshyra-olc5 for W13) rather than to the
closed design bead, so lifecycle semantics stay honest; eshyra-o9bd.19.8 remains
the design authority and is referenced from each description.

BOUNDARY THAT MUST NOT ERODE (design sections 8.4 and 14.3): campaign-rule
persistence and ruling lifecycle do not move out of eshyra-jhpt under any of
these items. W11 consumes; it does not own. If the jhpt interface proves
insufficient, the correct response is an amendment or a child under eshyra-jhpt,
never a discovery-local store.
